composition: Polygonal harbour library above a glass hall and the quay · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the harbour promenade at the mouth of Aarhus Å, Dokk1 is a glass hall under a dark polygonal roof that overhangs the podium, with broad concrete stairs down to the water. The night is overcast, about 12.3°C, and the quay is empty. Warm light shows through the glass. This is the waterfront library, not the half-timbered square at Den Gamle By and not the brick cube and rainbow ring at ARoS.
